home.meta_title: Kyoto Shabu-Shabu | Premium Meats & Seasonal Vegetables in Specialty Broth
home.meta_desc: 1-minute walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Station. Authentic shabu-shabu restaurant featuring freshly prepared broth and premium meats.
home.hero_subtitle: Authentic shabu-shabu with specialty broth and prime meat.
home.about_subheading: Savor authentic broth and selected ingredients
home.about_desc: Enjoy our house-crafted dashi broth prepared fresh every morning, alongside carefully selected premium beef and pork.
home.feature1_desc: A rich, fragrant broth brewed fresh every morning using premium kelp and bonito flakes.
home.feature2_desc: Thinly sliced premium meat ideally suited for shabu-shabu, freshly prepared per order.
home.feature3_desc: Relax and dine comfortably in warm wood-toned tables and semi-private dining spaces.
